notes:
Summary: Emberbrook is a mid-market B2B SaaS that builds an in-app support assistant and knowledge search for their flagship product. Initially evaluated Redwood hosted API during POC; impressed with latency profile and token-level cost visibility. Now moving to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.

POC takeaways (shorthand):
- Hosted POC: 4k daily active users simulated, avg conv length 220 tokens, p95 latency hosted ~120ms (some spikes during tails)
- Reranker + embeddings combo cut search time and improved top-3 precision; want to push model choice to a smaller quantized variant to lower cost
- Primary ask: 12-mo vs 24-mo committed capacity pricing comparison; they'd prefer 12-mo but open to 24-mo if ramp/credits included

Pricing negotiation notes:
- Asking for a blended committed vGPU rate tied to estimated monthly tokens (baseline 600M tokens/month)
- Burst: want 20% burst headroom for seasonal spikes; proposed models: (A) fixed burst pool with monthly cap but pre-purchased credits, (B) elastic burst billed at discounted overage rate up to a hard cap — they prefer A for predictability
- Overage: Emberbrook wants an overage cap (not unlimited billing). Proposed 150% of commit as hard cap, then throttling or emergency burst pricing. Finance asked for staged overage rate: 1.5x for first 50% over, 2x beyond that
- Ramp schedule: Need firm 4-week onboarding timeline to reach 50% of committed baseline, full ramp to 100% within 12 weeks. Request SLA credits if missed.

Security/legal:
- Must have SSO/SAML + audit logging. KMS integration required.Key rotation managed by customer. Data residency: US-only production. DPA required before data ingestion.

Stakeholder quotes: "We want predictable unit economics — surprises kill our margins." — Head of Product
"If we can get a reasonable ramp + burst model, Dedicated is the go-forward." — CTO

Next steps (internal): SE to produce final capacity calc & recommended commit tiers; sales to produce redline of MSA with explicit ramp/credits and burst model. Legal provisioning: send DPA template to Emberbrook legal.
